title: QA run · records-forms (38/44) · ba4afcc2 · 2026-10-19 · 34 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 6 NOT-RUN
body:
Round 2 of the 18.0 release sweep for `records-forms`: re-judges on `ba4afcc2` the clauses round 1 (#24572, subject `5b14b7f3`) left unjudged and that this environment can drive (A class); every other verdict is carried forward from #24572 below. Supersedes #24572 under checklist-test SKILL §5. Wave anchor: #24579.

## Environment fingerprint
- framework `ba4afcc2391922a86678bf5e47b1a0e4d2c87ff1` (pinned; one commit after round 1's `5b14b7f3`, a release-script fix — `git diff 5b14b7f3 ba4afcc2 -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/` is empty, so every item revision is unchanged and carried verdicts stay revision-valid)
- console `.objectui-sha` `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, built with `pnpm objectui:build` (deps `--concurrency=2`); `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamp equals the pin
- app: showcase, canonical boot `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa2/LABEL/ITEM.db`; own port + file DB per runner/item; scratch app copies for metadata-writing items; seed `--seed-admin` + showcase seed
- browser: Playwright, `executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, one context per runner, form sign-in
- timestamps 2026-10-19: environment prep 14:12–14:44 UTC (cold tree: install 39 s, `pnpm build` 10m20s, console build ~25 min); testing 14:45–15:42 UTC (+ rule-7 verifier 15:40–15:46 UTC)
- execution: three browser runner sub-agents in parallel (≤ 3 browser contexts machine-wide, one per runner), each on its own ports and file DB (:47531, :47541, :47561); metadata-writing items booted from scratch app copies; an independent rule-7 verifier re-derived conditional-rules-grid negative[1] on :47592

## Reproduction rules (fails)
### records-forms.conditional-rules-grid · negative[1] — stored paid invoice loads with editable locked cells (client lock race)

1. Canonical showcase boot (stock seed); sign in as admin@objectos.ai through the form.
2. In a fresh browser context open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice/record/INV-1003-ID/edit` (INV-1003 is seeded `status: paid`; `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice?filter=[["name","=","INV-1003"]]` gives the id). Do not touch the header.
3. Wait ≥ 10 s; read the first `tbody tr` of the Line Items grid: the product lookup button, Qty `input[type=number]` and Unit Price input.
   - Expected (invoice.object.ts: product/quantity/unit_price `readonlyWhen: parent.status == 'paid'`): all three disabled, as they are after a live flip to Paid.
   - Actual: all three enabled in 6 of 7 fresh loads (sampled at 3, 6 and 10 s; one load came up locked). Typing 7 into Qty is accepted and Save sends `POST /api/v1/batch … {"object":"showcase_invoice_line","action":"update","id":LINE,"data":{"quantity":7,"amount":349.93}}`.
4. Server consequence: the server's readonlyWhen strip keeps quantity 6 but stores the client-computed amount (349.93 = 7 × 49.99, but 6 × 49.99 = 299.94), and the invoice `total` roll-up becomes 349.93. Same thing over the API alone: `POST /api/v1/batch {"operations":[{"object":"showcase_invoice_line","action":"update","id":INV-1003-LINE,"data":{"quantity":9,"amount":449.91}}],"atomic":true}` → 200, line reads quantity 6 / amount 449.91, invoice total 449.91. (The `amount` comment in invoice.object.ts says the client-sent value is stored as-is, so this half is the documented trust model; the client lock race is what exposes it.)
5. Mechanism (objectui 4016370a, `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `MasterDetailLines`): `parentRecord` is scraped from the header DOM on mount and on timers at 120/360/800 ms plus `input`/`change` events. The header's edit-mode load (schema fetch → record load → RHF reset) fires no input event, so when it finishes after 800 ms `parent` stays `{}` and `parent.status == 'paid'` evaluates false.
- Self-check: state read from the `disabled` DOM property after a screenshot, no interaction before sampling; the typed value actually reached the batch (not a driver artifact); stamp equals pin, mechanism confirmed in the pinned source; hydration-race ruled out by sampling up to 10 s. Test data restored (line amount PATCHed back to 299.94, total 299.94).

### records-forms.action-location-matrix · acceptance[2] (record_related dispatch leg) + negative[2]
Boot: stock showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`), console stamp 4016370a == pin. Sign in admin@objectos.ai / admin123.
1. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_project/record/WEBSITE-RELAUNCH-ID?tab=related` (any project with tasks).
2. In the "Tasks" related list, open a row's menu: `getByRole('row').filter({hasText:'Design system'}).getByRole('button',{name:'Row actions'})` → menuitem "Log Time".
3. Expected: the declared form view opens for THAT task — `/_console/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=TASK-ID&recordObject=showcase_task`, prefilled (which is exactly what the same action does from the Task Detail quick-actions bar / title bar: `/_console/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=NszgRYReCy-v3CLH&recordObject=showcase_task`, Title "SEO migration plan" prefilled).
   Actual: navigates to bare `/_console/forms/showcase_task.form` — an empty CREATE form (Title empty, Project "Select…", Status "Select an option"); no GET of the clicked task is issued. Reproduced on 3 fresh loads with 3 rows (Design system, Content backlog, Build homepage).
Mechanism (objectui @ 4016370a): `packages/app-shell/src/views/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx` runRowAction retargets the row action by putting `objectName: childObject` / `recordId` on the action DEF and calls the page's shared `execute`; `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` executeForm reads the id and object only from `this.context` (the parent page: record = the project, objectName = showcase_project) and deliberately ignores `action.objectName` (objectui#4292). `crossesObjectBoundary('showcase_task.form','showcase_project')` → true → bare `/forms/:name`. So every `type:'form'` action placed at record_related opens a create form instead of the clicked row's edit form.
Self-check: ref-targeted role clicks (no coordinates); the same Log Time action dispatched from record_section on a fresh Task Detail load carried recordId correctly; hydration ruled out (row list rendered and screenshotted before the click); stale bundle ruled out (dist stamp == .objectui-sha, mechanism read from the same sha's source).
